title: A negatively oriented orthonormal frame σ of ν^⊥: det[ν, σ] = −1
statement: Let n ≥ 1 and ν ∈ ℝ^{n+1} with |ν| = 1. For x ∈ ℝ^{n+1} and a family a = (a_0, …, a_{n−1}) in ℝ^{n+1}, let [x, a] be the (n+1)×(n+1) real matrix whose column 0 is x and whose column l+1 is a_l (its entry in row r, column c is the r-th coordinate of the c-th column vector). Then there is an orthonormal family σ = (σ_0, …, σ_{n−1}) in ℝ^{n+1} with span{σ_0, …, σ_{n−1}} = (span{ν})^⊥ and det[ν, σ] = −1.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (ν : Euclid (n + 1)), 1 ≤ n → ‖ν‖ = 1 → ∃ σ : Fin n → Euclid (n + 1), Orthonormal ℝ σ ∧ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range σ) = (Submodule.span ℝ {ν})ᗮ ∧ Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun r c : Fin (n + 1) => (Fin.cons ν σ : Fin (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)) c r) = -1
